data.one_liner: Type-safe analytics event tracking generated from YAML configuration.
data.what_it_does: Generates type-safe Dart code, documentation, and export formats from YAML-based analytics tracking plans. Enforces parameter validation, allowed values, and multi-provider logging.
use_when: You want to maintain a centralized analytics tracking plan in YAML and generate type-safe tracking code.
You need automated validation for event parameters, regex rules, and allowed values.
You require multi-provider fan-out and documentation outputs for stakeholders.
avoid_when: You prefer writing all tracking code and event names manually without external plan files.
You do not use YAML configurations or code generation workflows in your project.
strengths: Ensures compile-time type safety for event names and parameters.
Generates documentation, exports, and supports multi-provider fan-out.
Includes validation rules and enum generation for allowed values.
weaknesses: Requires maintaining and syncing separate YAML configuration files.
Adds a code generation step to your development workflow.
data.setup_notes: Add analytics_gen to dependencies, create your YAML tracking plan, configure analytics_gen.yaml, and run the generator via CLI.
